comment: A Priest quits with #quit and answers Escape at end.c really_done()'s disclosure prompt, so the game ends on the blank terminal nh_terminate() leaves, which the recorder saves as an empty screen and the judge skips. The second segment starts a new game, whose legacy text from quest.lua must be the next scored screen. Seeds, datetimes, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
